caption:
Bar Taki is a tiny jazz bar tucked away in the crowded alleys of Shinjuku’s Golden Gai. Like many of the bars here, the space is small—fitting fewer than 10 people—so everyone sits shoulder to shoulder, sipping drinks and chatting.

Loud jazz music fills the room, and visitors from all over the world gather to drink, listen, and talk, creating a close and cozy vibe. If you’re lucky enough to get a seat by the window, you can even open it and chat with guests at the bar across the way—it’s such a unique and fun experience!

It’s easy to understand why Golden Gai is so loved. Coming here to experience this side of Tokyo’s nightlife culture, right in the heart of the city, is something truly special. Save this video for your next Tokyo trip!

🍣 This unique sushi stall lets you pick your own giant block of tuna, then they prepare it right in front of you however you like 😍🤤 Details & location 👇

🙆‍♂️The staff can speak English and were super wonderful, I wasn’t sure which tuna I’d like best so they shared recommendations and helped me pick 

🪑There are only about 6 seats, so if it’s full once you pick your tuna you get a number card to wait your turn to sit (but it goes quickly! I waited about 5 min).

📍Maguroya Kurogin, Kuromon Market, Osaka

#japan #japantravel #sushi".
transcription: If you love sushi and especially tuna, you have to check out this one-of-a-kind, customizable sushi stall in Osaka, Japan. First, you get a pick from their huge selection of freshly cut tuna fillets that range from lean to fatty tuna. Then they'll prepare your block of tuna right in front of you. You can choose sashimi, sushi, or a sushi bowl over rice. It's a little pricey since it's inside a popular fish market, but the quality of the tuna is the best and the experiences one you won't forget.
